changeSet.author: dts

preConditions.onFailMessage: admin_keycloak_user.person_code 存在重复值，跳过唯一索引创建，请先清理后手工建索引
preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from ( select person_code from admin_keycloak_user where person_code is not null group by person_code having count(*) > 1 ) dup

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uk_admin_kc_user_person_code ON admin_keycloak_user (person_code) WHERE person_code IS NOT NULL
